description: Offer the player 2-4 concrete things they could do next, as chips on the action bar. Attach `stakes` to anything that will be rolled, so the player can weigh the odds BEFORE committing — stakes revealed after the dice read as GM fiat. In a world that uses position and effect, set both (they default to risky and standard); elsewhere they're ignored and only the test (ability or skill, difficulty) is shown. Presentation only: nothing is resolved here, the roll happens when the player picks. Call once per turn, after the beat is decided. The player can always ignore these and type their own action.

actions.description: 2-4 is the sweet spot. These are affordances, not a menu — the player can always type something else.

disabled.description: Visible but unpickable, e.g. lacking an item.

hint.description: Free-form mechanical context. Prefer `stakes` when the action is a test.

kind.description: Dispatch category — mirrors the player-action protocol.

label.description: Imperative, 2-5 words, in the world's voice. e.g. 'Pick the grate lock'.

stakes.description: Pre-roll framing. Set this for anything that will be rolled — the player must be able to read the odds BEFORE choosing. Position and effect apply only in worlds that use them.

difficulty.description: Difficulty as display text — a level name or DC.

effect.description: How much this action accomplishes on a success. Defaults to standard; ignored in worlds without position and effect.

position.description: Risk level if this action is taken. Sets the consequence severity. Defaults to risky; ignored in worlds without position and effect.

name: suggest_actions
